nodes.name: REQ-CAP-01-manual-smoke.md
nodes.summary: Records the host-side smoke run for bootstrapping the League client capture process to READY state. It preserves redacted runtime evidence, operator steps, and acceptance-criteria mapping for REQ-CAP-01.

nodes.name: REQ-CAP-01-verification.md
nodes.summary: Captures the full verification report for documenting and validating the host capture startup workflow. It summarizes acceptance criteria, documentation-only scope, smoke evidence, and PR-ready review notes for REQ-CAP-01.

nodes.name: REQ-CAP-02-verification.md
nodes.summary: Documents verification for LCU credential discovery and sanitized startup failure handling in the host client. It tracks focused pytest coverage, smoke expectations for the League-closed path, and requirement completion evidence for REQ-CAP-02.

nodes.name: REQ-CAP-03-verification.md
nodes.summary: Describes verification for collecting a post-game LCU match snapshot after detecting the end of a custom game. It covers retry behavior, recoverable workflow failures, parser fixtures, and deferred live dogfood validation for REQ-CAP-03.

nodes.name: REQ-CAP-04-verification.md
nodes.summary: Documents verification for rejecting non-duel match snapshots before the client sends them to the server. It emphasizes the two-player validation rule, recoverable READY-state behavior, and automated proof for REQ-CAP-04.

nodes.name: REQ-CAP-05-verification.md
nodes.summary: Captures verification that the client submits valid match snapshots to the server ingest endpoint and handles transport or backend failures correctly. It focuses on API request tests, run-loop send orchestration, and deferred end-to-end dogfood proof for REQ-CAP-05.

nodes.name: REQ-SRV-01-manual-smoke.md
nodes.summary: Provides live manual smoke evidence for the raw-event ingest API against a running local server and configured database. It demonstrates first-ingest acceptance, duplicate rejection, invalid-body handling, and the exact curl workflow for REQ-SRV-01.

nodes.name: REQ-SRV-01-verification.md
nodes.summary: Documents end-to-end verification for accepting raw match snapshot events on the server HTTP boundary. It combines unit, HTTP, integration, and manual smoke evidence while tracing duplicate handling, validation errors, and follow-up client idempotency work for REQ-SRV-01.
